purpose: Make natural-run liveness durable with exactly one GitHub mutation and zero prerequisite or follow-up external calls inside the scheduled execution.

root_cause_basis.observed_failure_pattern: Post-r12 Flow triggered at 06:24:48Z and remained enabled, but the scheduled GitHub create_file still did not appear. Earlier failed lanes sometimes auto-paused about 64 seconds after trigger. GitHub app-specific permission remains Allow all actions.
root_cause_basis.inference_boundary: Task enablement and connector persistence are separate health dimensions. The registry does not expose the exact internal reason when a scheduled connector action disappears, so platform-internal causation is not asserted.
root_cause_basis.corrective_principle: Keep the ChatGPT scheduled critical path at one external call; use GitHub-native reconciliation as independent durability; separately classify scheduler trigger health versus connector persistence health.

steps: Perform only local timestamp and nearest-slot computation before persistence.
Derive RUN_ID=<lane>-<UTC YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ> from the invocation clock.

FIRST AND ONLY EXTERNAL ACTION: invoke connected GitHub create_file directly against reppiks490/Icarus-engine on branch automation/omega-native-v2 at automation_intelligence/omega_stack_native_v2/<lane>/runs/<RUN_ID>.json.

Write the immutable v4.3 liveness receipt with exact identity, nominal scheduled_for, started_at_utc, execution_authorized=false, verification_method=GITHUB_CREATE_FILE_RESPONSE, and run_origin=NATURAL_SCHEDULE.
Commit message is automation: <RUN_ID> liveness [skip ci].
After create_file returns, stop immediately. No second tool call.

phase2_work.rule: No phase-2 work occurs inside the natural scheduled run under r12. Work is deliberately outside the liveness critical path.

immutable_append_policy.duplicate_path_behavior: Treat ALREADY_EXISTS as duplicate/collision evidence; do not retry or overwrite inside the same run.

scheduler_jitter.rule: Use nominal slot in scheduled_for. Jitter within tolerance is transport timing, not a persistence failure.

acceptance.liveness_single_run: One natural immutable run file is created successfully with exact identity and required values.
acceptance.sustained_lane: Two consecutive natural v4.3 immutable liveness files with distinct RUN_IDs.
acceptance.work_completion: NOT_APPLICABLE_IN_R12_SCHEDULED_LIVENESS_ONLY; scheduled phase-2 work is disabled and tracked separately if performed outside the natural critical path.
acceptance.stack_5_of_5: All five enabled authoritative lanes satisfy sustained_lane while scheduler registry remains exactly five enabled authoritative lanes; r12 does not require scheduled work receipts.
acceptance.scheduler_trigger_health: Authoritative task remains enabled and advances last_run_time on its intended cadence.
acceptance.connector_persistence_health: Natural immutable run receipt exists with exact identity/slot fields and valid jitter.
acceptance.watchdog_health: GitHub Actions watchdog completes successfully and writes only reconciliation namespace transitions.

legacy_artifacts.v3: heartbeat.json, checkpoint.json, core/, history/, finalization/ are read-only historical evidence.
legacy_artifacts.v4_2: Historical write-first latest.json receipts; useful evidence but not authoritative for v4.3 natural-run acceptance.

invariants: Only ChatGPT AI-plane natural runs may write <lane>/runs/ and use run_origin=NATURAL_SCHEDULE.
The GitHub watchdog writes only under reconciliation/ and never writes natural runs/ or work/ receipts.
Missing, backlog, late-arrival, and recovery history is append-only; existing non-identical artifacts are never overwritten.
A watchdog or recovery artifact must never be promoted into a fabricated natural receipt.
A GitHub Actions failure remains visible as a failure and must not fall back silently to another credential.
watchdog_reconciliation.schedule_design: two independent 10-minute streams staggered by five minutes; avoids :00 load concentration and reduces dependence on one schedule stream

natural_slot_attribution.rule: Capture started_at_utc, convert to America/Chicago, choose nearest lane-specific hourly boundary considering previous and next; tie chooses earlier.

phase2_recovery.rule: Recovery backlog remains durable under reconciliation/, but natural scheduled runs do not inspect or process it under r12.
phase2_recovery.failure_semantics: Backlog remains unresolved until processed outside the natural liveness critical path.

r12_probe_evidence.conclusion: r12 reduced the auto-disable failure surface in this probe, but connector delivery remains intermittent
